blur_detection.description: The image exhibits clear, sharp text with well-defined edges throughout the document.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action required as text clarity is excellent for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: Strong contrast between black text and white background with red header elements provides excellent readability.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No improvement needed as contrast is optimal for automated text extraction.

glare_identification.description: No visible glare, reflections, or overexposed areas detected on the document surface.
glare_identification.recommendation: Current lighting conditions are ideal for document scanning.

water_stains.description: No water damage, discoloration, or staining visible on the document.
water_stains.recommendation: No action required as document shows no signs of liquid exposure.

tears_or_folds.description: Document appears flat with no visible creases, folds, tears, or physical damage.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Continue to handle and store document in current manner to maintain condition.

cut_off_detection.description: All document edges are fully visible with appropriate margins around content.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Current framing is appropriate; maintain similar positioning for future document scanning.

missing_sections.description: Document indicates 'Please see next page for payment details' but subsequent pages are not included in the image.
missing_sections.recommendation: Scan and include all referenced pages to capture complete payment information.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows, or objects obstructing any portion of the document content.
obstructions.recommendation: Current scanning technique is excellent; maintain similar approach for future document captures.
